tbBuild_Fusion: Builds the Fusion host program that a project with ActiveX controls may need, without building the project.
tbBuild_SwitchToWin32: Sets the build target to 32-bit Windows.
tbBuild_SwitchToWin64: Sets the build target to 64-bit Windows.
tbCallStack_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Call Stack panel.
tbCompiler_Restart: Restarts the compiler. With the Alt key held down, it also empties the LLVM compiler cache.
tbCompiler_RestartAndFlushLlvmCache: Restarts the compiler and empties the LLVM compiler cache.
tbDebug_BreakpointsClear: Removes every breakpoint from the project.
tbDebug_RunOrPreview: Runs the procedure at the cursor, or shows a preview of the form when the active file is a form.
tbDebug_SetNextExecutionStatement: At a breakpoint, makes the line at the cursor the next one to run.
tbDebug_StartOrContinue: Starts the project, or continues it from a breakpoint.
tbDebug_StepInto: At a breakpoint, runs the current statement and stops at the next, entering any procedure it calls.
tbDebug_StepOut: At a breakpoint, runs on until the current procedure ends and stops in its caller.
tbDebug_StepOver: At a breakpoint, runs the current statement and stops at the next, without entering any procedure it calls.
tbDebug_ToggleBreakOnAllErrors: Turns the project's Break On All Errors setting on or off.
tbDebug_ToggleBreakpoint: Sets a breakpoint on the cursor's line, or removes the one that is there.
tbDebug_ToggleDebuggable: Turns the project's Allow Breakpoints (Debuggable) setting on or off.
tbDebugConsole_ClipboardCopyAll: Copies everything in the Debug Console to the clipboard.
tbDebugConsole_ClipboardCopyAllWithTimes: Copies everything in the Debug Console to the clipboard, each line with its time.
tbDebugConsole_ExecuteCode: Runs the line of code given as its argument in the Debug Console, as in `tbDebugConsole_ExecuteCode('? 6*7')`. It does nothing without an argument.
tbDebugConsole_ExecuteEnteredLine: Runs the line typed in the Debug Console's entry box, or inserts the selected entry of the completion list.
tbDebugConsole_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Debug Console's entry box.
tbDebugConsole_GoToDefinition: Goes to the definition of the symbol selected in the Debug Console's completion list.
tbDebugConsole_HistoryCycleNext: In the Debug Console's entry box, shows the next line of its history.
tbDebugConsole_HistoryCyclePrevious: In the Debug Console's entry box, shows the previous line of its history.
tbDebugConsole_SelectAllEntryBox: Selects the whole text of the Debug Console's entry box.
tbDebugConsole_ToggleAutoScroll: Turns the Debug Console's Auto Scroll on or off.
tbDebugConsole_ToggleInvertOutputDirecti: Turns the Debug Console's Invert Output Direction option on or off.
tbDebugConsole_ToggleShowTimestamps: Turns the Debug Console's Show Timestamps option on or off.
tbDebugConsole_TurnAutoScrollOff: Turns the Debug Console's Auto Scroll off.
tbDebugConsole_TurnAutoScrollOn: Turns the Debug Console's Auto Scroll on.
tbDebugConsole_TurnInvertOutputDirection: Turns the Debug Console's Invert Output Direction option off.
Turns the Debug Console's Invert Output Direction option on.
tbDebugConsole_TurnShowTimestampsOff: Turns the Debug Console's Show Timestamps option off.
tbDebugConsole_TurnShowTimestampsOn: Turns the Debug Console's Show Timestamps option on.
tbEditor_ActivateNextTab: Switches to the next editor tab.
tbEditor_ActivatePrevTab: Switches to the previous editor tab.
tbEditor_AddCursorAbove: Adds a cursor on the line above.
tbEditor_AddCursorBelow: Adds a cursor on the line below.
tbEditor_AddCursorsAtLineEndsOfSelection: Puts a cursor at the end of each line of the selection.
tbEditor_AddSelectionToNextFindMatch: Adds the next occurrence of the selected text to the selection, with a cursor at each.
tbEditor_ChangeAllOccurrences: Selects every occurrence of the word at the cursor, for changing all at once.
tbEditor_ClearBookmarks: Removes every bookmark from the current document.
tbEditor_ClearBookmarksProject: Removes every bookmark from the project.
tbEditor_ClipboardCopy: Copies the selection to the clipboard, replacing tabs with spaces.
tbEditor_ClipboardCopyWithSyntaxHighligh: Copies the selection to the clipboard with its syntax colours.
tbEditor_ClipboardCut: Cuts the selection to the clipboard, replacing tabs with spaces.
tbEditor_ClipboardCutPlain: Cuts the selection to the clipboard as plain text, with the editor's own handling of tabs left out.
tbEditor_ClipboardPaste: Pastes the clipboard into the code editor, re-indenting the pasted text.
tbEditor_ClipboardPasteAsComment: Pastes the clipboard into the code editor as comment lines.
tbEditor_ClipboardPlainCopy: Copies the selection to the clipboard as plain text, with the editor's own handling of tabs left out.
tbEditor_ClipboardPlainPaste: Pastes the clipboard into the code editor exactly as it is, without re-indenting.
tbEditor_CodeSelector1_Dropdown: Opens box 1 above the code editor, which lists the components of the file.
tbEditor_CodeSelector2_Dropdown: Opens box 2 above the code editor, which lists the objects of the component.
tbEditor_CodeSelector3_Dropdown: Opens box 3 above the code editor, which lists the procedures or events.
tbEditor_CommentSelection: Turns the selected lines into comments.
tbEditor_ConvertIndentationToSpaces: Replaces the tabs that indent the document's lines with spaces.
tbEditor_ConvertIndentationToTabs: Replaces the spaces that indent the document's lines with tabs.
tbEditor_CopyLineDown: Copies the current line, or the selected lines, below themselves.
tbEditor_CopyLineUp: Copies the current line, or the selected lines, above themselves.
tbEditor_CursorMoveBottom: Moves the cursor to the end of the document.
tbEditor_CursorMoveDown: Moves the cursor down one line.
tbEditor_CursorMoveEndOfLine: Moves the cursor to the end of the line.
tbEditor_CursorMoveLeft: Moves the cursor one character to the left.
tbEditor_CursorMoveLeftWord: Moves the cursor to the start of the previous word.
tbEditor_CursorMovePageDown: Moves the cursor down by one page.
tbEditor_CursorMovePageUp: Moves the cursor up by one page.
tbEditor_CursorMoveRight: Moves the cursor one character to the right.
tbEditor_CursorMoveRightWord: Moves the cursor to the start of the next word.
tbEditor_CursorMoveStartOfLine: Moves the cursor to the first column of the line.
tbEditor_CursorMoveStartOfLineHome: Moves the cursor to the first non-blank character of the line, or to the first column if it is already there.
tbEditor_CursorMoveTop: Moves the cursor to the start of the document.
tbEditor_CursorMoveUp: Moves the cursor up one line.
tbEditor_CursorRedo: Redoes a cursor movement or selection change that Cursor Undo undid.
tbEditor_CursorSelectBottom: Extends the selection to the end of the document.
tbEditor_CursorSelectDown: Extends the selection down one line.
tbEditor_CursorSelectLeft: Extends the selection one character to the left.
tbEditor_CursorSelectLeftWord: Extends the selection to the start of the previous word.
tbEditor_CursorSelectLineEnd: Extends the selection to the end of the line.
tbEditor_CursorSelectLineStart: Extends the selection to the first column of the line.
tbEditor_CursorSelectLineStartHome: Extends the selection to the first non-blank character of the line, or to the first column if it is already there.
tbEditor_CursorSelectPageDown: Extends the selection down by one page.
tbEditor_CursorSelectPageUp: Extends the selection up by one page.
tbEditor_CursorSelectRight: Extends the selection one character to the right.
tbEditor_CursorSelectRightWord: Extends the selection to the start of the next word.
tbEditor_CursorSelectTop: Extends the selection to the start of the document.
tbEditor_CursorSelectUp: Extends the selection up one line.
tbEditor_CursorUndo: Undoes the last cursor movement or selection change, without undoing any text change.
tbEditor_DecreaseFontSize: Makes the code editor's font one pixel smaller, down to a size of 8 pixels, and saves the size as the Code Editor Font Size option.
tbEditor_DeleteLeft: Deletes the character before the cursor, or the selection.
tbEditor_DeleteLeftWord: Deletes the word before the cursor.
tbEditor_DeleteLines: Deletes the current line, or the selected lines.
tbEditor_DeleteRight: Deletes the character after the cursor, or the selection.
tbEditor_DeleteRightWord: Deletes the word after the cursor.
tbEditor_ExpandLineSelection: Extends the selection to include the whole of the current line.
tbEditor_ExpandSelection: Widens the selection to the next larger syntactic block.
tbEditor_Find: Opens the Find and Replace panel, searching for the selected text, or the word at the cursor.
tbEditor_FindReplace: Opens the Find and Replace panel, as the Find command does.
tbEditor_FindSelectedNext: Moves to the next occurrence of the selected text.
tbEditor_FindSelectedPrev: Moves to the previous occurrence of the selected text.
tbEditor_FindWidget_Next: Moves to the next match of the current search.
tbEditor_FindWidget_Prev: Moves to the previous match of the current search.
tbEditor_FindWidget_SelectAllMatches: Selects every match of the current search in the editor.
tbEditor_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the code editor.
tbEditor_Fold: Folds the block at the cursor.
tbEditor_FoldAll: Folds every block in the document.
tbEditor_FoldProcedures: Folds every procedure in the file except the one the cursor is in.
tbEditor_GoToDefinition: Goes to the definition of the symbol at the cursor.
tbEditor_GotoLineColumn: Opens the box for going to a line and column.
tbEditor_IncreaseFontSize: Makes the code editor's font one pixel larger and saves the size as the Code Editor Font Size option.
tbEditor_Indent: Indents the line or the selected lines, or inserts a tab at the cursor.
tbEditor_InsertAmpersand: Types an ampersand. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertBackslash: Types a backslash. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertBracketOpen: Types an opening parenthesis, or puts the selected text in parentheses.
tbEditor_InsertColon: Types a colon. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertComma: Types a comma. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertEquals: Types an equals sign. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertExclamation: Types an exclamation mark. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertLineAbove: Inserts an empty line above the cursor's line and moves the cursor to it.
tbEditor_InsertLineBelow: Inserts an empty line below the cursor's line and moves the cursor to it.
tbEditor_InsertLineBreak: Breaks the line at the cursor, as the Enter key does. This is bound to the key so that the IDE can do its own work on the new line.
tbEditor_InsertMinus: Types a minus sign. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertMultiply: Types an asterisk. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertPeriod: Types a full stop. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertPlus: Types a plus sign. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertSlash: Types a slash. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_InsertSpace: Types a space. The key is bound to a command so that the IDE can react to it.
tbEditor_JumpToNextProblem: Moves the cursor to the next error or warning in the document.
tbEditor_JumpToPrevProblem: Moves the cursor to the previous error or warning in the document.
tbEditor_LastPosition: Returns to the most recently recorded position, at the start of its line, opening its file if needed.
tbEditor_MoveLinesDown: Moves the current line, or the selected lines, down one line.
tbEditor_MoveLinesUp: Moves the current line, or the selected lines, up one line.
tbEditor_MoveToProcedureNext: Moves the cursor to the start of the next procedure.
tbEditor_MoveToProcedurePrev: Moves the cursor to the start of the previous procedure.
tbEditor_NextBookmark: Moves the cursor to the next bookmark.
tbEditor_OpenTabsDropDown: Opens the list of open editor tabs.
tbEditor_Outdent: Outdents the line or the selected lines.
tbEditor_PrevBookmark: Moves the cursor to the previous bookmark.
tbEditor_Redo: Redoes the last change that was undone in the current document.
tbEditor_RenameSymbol: Renames the symbol at the cursor everywhere it is used.
tbEditor_ReopenLastClosedTab: Reopens the editor tab that was closed last.
tbEditor_Save: Never runs: saving a single document is turned off. Use the commands that save the project.
tbEditor_ScrollTabLeft: Scrolls the row of editor tabs to the left. The left tab button runs it.
tbEditor_ScrollTabRight: Scrolls the row of editor tabs to the right. The right tab button runs it.
tbEditor_SelectAllMatches: Selects every occurrence of the word at the cursor, or of the selected text.
tbEditor_ShowContextMenu: Opens the code editor's context menu at the top left of the editor.
tbEditor_ShowMonacoCommandPalette: Opens the command palette of the Monaco code editor.
tbEditor_ShrinkSelection: Narrows the selection to the next smaller syntactic block.
tbEditor_SortLinesAscending: Sorts the selected lines in ascending order.
tbEditor_SortLinesDescending: Sorts the selected lines in descending order.
tbEditor_SwitchToCode: Switches from a form designer to the code of the same file.
tbEditor_SwitchToFormDesign: Switches from the code of a file to its form designer.
tbEditor_SwitchToggleFormDesignCode: Switches between the form designer and the code of the same file.
tbEditor_ToggleAdvancedInfoOnHover: Turns the Show Advanced Info On Hover option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleAutoPrettifyCode: Turns the project's Auto Prettify option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleBlockComment: Wraps the selection in a block comment, or removes the block comment around it.
tbEditor_ToggleBookmark: Sets a bookmark on the cursor's line, or removes the one that is there.
tbEditor_ToggleCodeFoldingAlways: Turns on or off showing the code folding arrows all the time, not only when the pointer is over the margin.
tbEditor_ToggleCodeFoldingVisibility: Shows or hides the code folding arrows.
tbEditor_ToggleCodeHintsAlwaysVisible: Turns the Code Hints Always Visible option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleCodeLensShowProc: Turns the project's Show CodeLens Run Procedure option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleLineComment: Comments the selected lines, or uncomments them if they are all comments already.
tbEditor_ToggleShowCodeHints: Shows or hides the inline code hints.
tbEditor_ToggleShowIndentGuides: Shows or hides the indent guides.
tbEditor_ToggleShowLineNumbers: Shows or hides the line numbers.
tbEditor_ToggleShowSingleRowOfTabs: Turns the Show Single Row Of Tabs option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleStickyScroll: Turns the Sticky Scroll option on or off.
tbEditor_ToggleWordWrap: Turns word wrap on or off in the code editor.
tbEditor_TransformToLowercase: Changes the selected text to lower case.
tbEditor_TransformToSnakecase: Changes the selected text to snake case.
tbEditor_TransformToTitlecase: Changes the selected text to title case.
tbEditor_TransformToUppercase: Changes the selected text to upper case.
tbEditor_TurnShowCodeHintsOff: Hides the inline code hints. The Ctrl key runs it when it is released.
tbEditor_TurnShowCodeHintsOn: Shows the inline code hints. The Ctrl key runs it when it goes down.
tbEditor_TurnWordWrapOff: Turns word wrap off in the code editor.
tbEditor_TurnWordWrapOn: Turns word wrap on in the code editor.
tbEditor_UncommentSelection: Removes the comment marker from the selected lines.
tbEditor_Undo: Undoes the last change in the current document.
tbEditor_Unfold: Unfolds the block at the cursor.
tbEditor_UnfoldAll: Unfolds every block in the document.
tbEditor_UnfoldProcedures: Unfolds every procedure in the file.
tbFileSystem_AddClassCLS: Adds a class in a .cls file to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddClassTWIN: Adds a class in a .twin file to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddCustomControlsForm: Adds a CustomControls form to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the CustomControls package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_AddFolder: Adds a folder to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddModuleBAS: Adds a module in a .bas file to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddModuleTWIN: Adds a module in a .twin file to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddOtherFile: Adds a file of any other type to the project, with a name box for its name.
tbFileSystem_AddResourceMessageTable: Adds a message table to the project's resources and opens it.
tbFileSystem_AddResourceStringTable: Adds a string table to the project's resources and opens it.
tbFileSystem_AddResourceVisualStylesMani: Adds the Visual Styles manifest to the project's resources and opens it.
tbFileSystem_AddWindowsForm: Adds a Windows form to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the WinNativeForms package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_AddWindowsMDIForm: Adds a Windows MDI form to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the WinNativeForms package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_AddWindowsPropertyPage: Adds a Windows property page to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the WinNativeForms package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_AddWindowsReport: Adds a Windows report to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the WinNativeForms package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_AddWindowsUserControl: Adds a Windows user control to the project, with a name box for its name. If the project does not reference the WinNativeForms package, asks to add it.
tbFileSystem_ImportFile: Opens the dialog for choosing files to import into the project.
tbFindReplace_Cancel: Closes the Find and Replace panel, or hides it if it is floating.
tbFindReplace_FocusCurrentModule: Chooses the Current Module scope in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusCurrentProcedure: Chooses the Current Procedure scope in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusCurrentProject: Chooses the Current Project scope in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusDirection: Moves the focus to the Direction box of the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusFindWhat: Moves the focus to the Find What box of the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusMatchCaseToggle: Turns the Match Case option of the Find and Replace panel on or off.
tbFindReplace_FocusNext: Finds the next match in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusReplaceWith: Moves the focus to the Replace With box of the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_FocusUsePatternMatchingTog: Turns the Use Pattern Matching option of the Find and Replace panel on or off.
tbFindReplace_FocusWholeWordOnlyToggle: Turns the Whole Word Only option of the Find and Replace panel on or off.
tbFindReplace_HidePanel: Closes the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_Next: Finds the next match in the Find and Replace panel, or in the editor's quick find box when only that is showing.
tbFindReplace_Prev: Finds the previous match in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_ReplaceAll: Replaces every match in the scope chosen in the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindReplace_ReplaceNext: Replaces the current match in the Find and Replace panel and finds the next.
tbFindReplace_ShowPanel: Shows the Find and Replace panel.
tbFindWidget_FindNext: In the quick find box, moves to the next match.
tbFindWidget_FindNextAlways: In the quick find box, moves to the next match. It has no default key.
tbFindWidget_FindNextInSelection: In the quick find box, moves to the next occurrence of the selected text.
tbFindWidget_FindPrev: In the quick find box, moves to the previous match. It has no default key.
tbFindWidget_FindPrevInSelection: In the quick find box, moves to the previous occurrence of the selected text.
tbFindWidget_FindPrevious: Has the default key Shift+Enter, but the IDE has no command of this name. The command that moves to the previous match in the quick find box is tbFindWidget_FindPrev.
tbFindWidget_Hide: Closes the editor's quick find box.
tbFindWidget_HistoryCycleNext: In the quick find box, shows the next entry of the search history.
tbFindWidget_HistoryCyclePrevious: In the quick find box, shows the previous entry of the search history.
tbFindWidget_ShowFind: Opens the editor's quick find box.
tbFindWidget_ShowReplace: Opens the editor's quick find and replace box.
tbFormDesginer_DecreaseSpacingHorizontal: Narrows the horizontal gaps between the selected controls by one grid step.
tbFormDesginer_DecreaseSpacingVertical: Narrows the vertical gaps between the selected controls by one grid step.
tbFormDesginer_IncreaseSpacingHorizontal: Widens the horizontal gaps between the selected controls by one grid step.
tbFormDesginer_IncreaseSpacingVertical: Widens the vertical gaps between the selected controls by one grid step.
tbFormDesginer_MakeEqualSpacingHorizonta: Spaces three or more selected controls evenly from left to right.
tbFormDesginer_MakeEqualSpacingVertical: Spaces three or more selected controls evenly from top to bottom.
tbFormDesginer_RemoveSpacingHorizontal: Removes the horizontal gaps between the selected controls.
tbFormDesginer_RemoveSpacingVertical: Removes the vertical gaps between the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsBott: Aligns the bottom edges of the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsCent: Aligns the horizontal centres of the selected controls.
Aligns the vertical centres of the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsLeft: Aligns the left edges of the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsRigh: Aligns the right edges of the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsToGr: Moves the selected controls to the nearest grid points.
tbFormDesigner_AlignSelectedControlsTop: Aligns the top edges of the selected controls.
tbFormDesigner_BringControlToFront: Brings the selected controls to the front.
tbFormDesigner_CenterSelectedGroupInCont: Centres the selected controls as a group, from left to right, in their container.
Centres the selected controls as a group, from top to bottom, in their container.
tbFormDesigner_ClipboardCopy: Copies the selected controls to the clipboard.
tbFormDesigner_ClipboardCut: Cuts the selected controls to the clipboard.
tbFormDesigner_ClipboardPaste: Pastes the controls on the clipboard into the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_ClipboardPasteControlArra: Pastes the controls on the clipboard with their names kept, so that they join the control arrays of the controls with those names.
tbFormDesigner_DuplicateControlsIntoCont: Duplicates the selected controls as members of control arrays.
tbFormDesigner_DuplicateControlsWithNewN: Duplicates the selected controls, giving each copy a new name.
tbFormDesigner_LaunchPreview: Runs a preview of the form being designed.
tbFormDesigner_LockAllControls: Locks every control on the form.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorCopy: In the menu editor, copies the selected menu item to the clipboard.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorCut: In the menu editor, cuts the selected menu item to the clipboard.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorDelete: In the menu editor, deletes the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorInsertAbove: In the menu editor, inserts a new item above the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorInsertBelow: In the menu editor, inserts a new item below the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorInsertLeft: In the menu editor, inserts a new menu to the left of the selected top-level menu.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorInsertRight: In the menu editor, inserts a new menu to the right of the selected top-level menu.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorInsertSeperator: In the menu editor, inserts a separator below the selected menu item.
In the menu editor, inserts a separator above the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorMoveDown: In the menu editor, moves the selected menu item down one place.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorMoveLeft: In the menu editor, moves the selected top-level menu one place to the left.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorMoveRight: In the menu editor, moves the selected top-level menu one place to the right.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorMoveUp: In the menu editor, moves the selected menu item up one place.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorPasteAfter: In the menu editor, pastes the clipboard after the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorPasteBefore: In the menu editor, pastes the clipboard before the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorPasteInto: In the menu editor, pastes the clipboard into the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorRename: In the menu editor, renames the selected menu item.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorToggleChecked: In the menu editor, turns the Checked property of the selected menu item on or off.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorToggleEnabled: In the menu editor, turns the Enabled property of the selected menu item on or off.
tbFormDesigner_MenuEditorToggleVisible: In the menu editor, turns the Visible property of the selected menu item on or off.
tbFormDesigner_MoveSelectedControlsDown: Moves the selected controls down by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
tbFormDesigner_MoveSelectedControlsLeft: Moves the selected controls left by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
tbFormDesigner_MoveSelectedControlsRight: Moves the selected controls right by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
tbFormDesigner_MoveSelectedControlsUp: Moves the selected controls up by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
tbFormDesigner_Redo: Redoes the last change that was undone in the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_ResizeSelectedControlsNar: Makes the selected controls narrower by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
Makes the selected controls as narrow as the narrowest of them.
tbFormDesigner_ResizeSelectedControlsSho: Makes the selected controls shorter by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
Makes the selected controls as short as the shortest of them.
tbFormDesigner_ResizeSelectedControlsTal: Makes the selected controls taller by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
Makes the selected controls as tall as the tallest of them.
tbFormDesigner_ResizeSelectedControlsWid: Makes the selected controls wider by one grid step, or one pixel when the grid is off.
Makes the selected controls as wide as the widest of them.
tbFormDesigner_SelectAllControls: Selects every control on the form.
tbFormDesigner_SelectParentOfSelectedCon: With a control selected, selects its container, or the form.
tbFormDesigner_SelectToolboxPointer: With no control selected, returns to the pointer tool in the Toolbox.
tbFormDesigner_SendControlToBack: Sends the selected controls to the back.
tbFormDesigner_ShowSelectedControlActive: Opens the property page of the selected ActiveX control.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleAlignControlsToGrid: Turns on or off snapping controls to the grid.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleControlOutlines: Shows or hides the outlines of the controls.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleGridIndicators: Shows or hides the grid in the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleInPlaceEditingToolb: Shows or hides the small in-place editing toolbar below a selected control.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleLockAllControls: Locks every control on the form that is unlocked, and unlocks each one that is locked.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleLockSelectedControl: Locks each selected control that is unlocked, and unlocks each one that is locked.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleMultiColouredGrabbe: Turns the multi-coloured selection handles on or off.
tbFormDesigner_ToggleShowTabIndex: Shows or hides the tab index of each control.
tbFormDesigner_TurnAlignControlsToGridOf: Turns off snapping controls to the grid.
tbFormDesigner_TurnAlignControlsToGridOn: Turns on snapping controls to the grid.
tbFormDesigner_TurnControlOutlinesOff: Hides the outlines of the controls.
tbFormDesigner_TurnControlOutlinesOn: Shows the outlines of the controls.
tbFormDesigner_TurnGridIndicatorsOff: Hides the grid in the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_TurnGridIndicatorsOn: Shows the grid in the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_TurnInPlaceEditingToolbar: Hides the small in-place editing toolbar below a selected control.
Shows the small in-place editing toolbar below a selected control.
tbFormDesigner_TurnShowTabIndexOff: Hides the tab index of each control. The Ctrl key runs it when it is released.
tbFormDesigner_TurnShowTabIndexOn: Shows the tab index of each control. The Ctrl key runs it when it goes down.
tbFormDesigner_Undo: Undoes the last change in the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_UnlockAllControls: Unlocks every control on the form.
tbFormDesigner_ZoomDecrease: Moves to the next smaller zoom in the form designer's zoom list.
tbFormDesigner_ZoomDropDown: Opens the zoom list of the form designer.
tbFormDesigner_ZoomIncrease: Moves to the next larger zoom in the form designer's zoom list.
tbHelp_AskErrorReporting: Opens the dialog that asks whether the IDE may report its errors automatically.
tbHelp_EnterLicenceKey: Opens the dialog for entering a licence key.
tbHelp_OpenDiscordWebsite: Opens the twinBASIC Discord invitation in the default web browser.
tbHelp_OpenGithubWebsite: Opens the twinBASIC GitHub repository in the default web browser.
tbHelp_OpenKofiWebsite: Opens the twinBASIC Ko-fi page in the default web browser.
tbHelp_OpenTwitterWebsite: Opens the twinBASIC author's Twitter page in the default web browser.
tbHelp_PurchaseALicence: Opens the twinBASIC licence purchase page in the default web browser.
tbHelp_ToggleCompilerTraceMode: Turns the compiler's trace mode on or off and restarts the compiler.
tbHelp_ToggleExpandSignatureHelp: Expands or collapses the signature help that is showing.
tbHistory_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the History panel.
tbIde_DecreaseFontSize: Makes the IDE's font one pixel smaller, down to a size of 8 pixels.
tbIde_IncreaseFontSize: Makes the IDE's font one pixel larger.
tbIdeDevTools_Show: Opens the developer tools of the IDE's web view.
tbIdeWindow_MaximizeOrRestore: Maximises the IDE window, or restores it when it is already maximised.
tbIntellisense_AcceptSelectedEntry: Inserts the selected entry of the completion list, then types the key that was pressed.
tbIntellisense_AcceptSelectedOrFirstEntr: Inserts the selected entry of the completion list, or the first entry if none is selected.
tbIntellisense_Cancel: Closes the completion list and the signature help.
tbIntellisense_SelectNext: Selects the next entry of the open completion list.
tbIntellisense_SelectPrevious: Selects the previous entry of the open completion list.
tbIntellisense_ShowAfterKeyPress: Opens the completion list after any key that is not one of the keys its binding excludes, according to the IntelliSense mode option.
tbIntellisense_ShowNow: Opens the completion list at the cursor.
tbKeyboardShortcuts_ShowManageKeyboardSh: Opens the dialog for managing keyboard shortcut groups.
tbKeyboardShortcuts_ShowWarningCannotDis: Shows a message that the built-in keyboard shortcut group cannot be turned off, and says to override a command in a group of your own instead.
tbKeyboardShortcuts_ToggleActiveKeyboard: Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 1 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 10 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 2 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 3 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 4 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 5 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 6 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 7 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 8 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
Turns on or off the keyboard shortcut group that is number 9 in the list of your own groups, if there is one.
tbMenu_ExecuteFocusedEntry: While a menu is open, runs the focused entry.
tbMenu_FocusAdjacentDown: While a menu is open, moves the focus to the entry below.
tbMenu_FocusAdjacentLeft: While a menu is open, closes the open submenu, or moves to the menu on the left.
tbMenu_FocusAdjacentRight: While a menu is open, opens the submenu of the focused entry, or moves to the menu on the right.
tbMenu_FocusAdjacentUp: While a menu is open, moves the focus to the entry above.
tbMisc_AltKeyStateDown: Records that the Alt key is held down, so that releasing it alone can open the File menu. The IDE uses it internally.
tbMisc_AltKeyStateUp: Opens the File menu when the Alt key is released without another key having been pressed, or closes a menu that is open.
tbMisc_PreventDefaultKeyBehaviour: Stops the web view's own handling of the key. The IDE binds it to keys whose default action it does not want.
tbMisc_SaveProjectMetaStateInTwinproj: Saves the project's meta state to the project file and shows a message box.
tbMisc_ShiftKeyStateDown: Records that the Shift key is held down. The IDE uses it internally.
tbMisc_ShiftKeyStateUp: Records that the Shift key has been released. The IDE uses it internally.
tbOpenEditors_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Open Editors panel.
tbOutline_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Outline panel.
tbPackagePublishing_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Package Publishing panel.
tbPanels_SaveCurrentPanelLayoutAs: Asks for a name and saves the current panel layout under it.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom1: Switches to the panel layout that is number 1 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom10: Switches to the panel layout that is number 10 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom2: Switches to the panel layout that is number 2 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom3: Switches to the panel layout that is number 3 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom4: Switches to the panel layout that is number 4 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom5: Switches to the panel layout that is number 5 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom6: Switches to the panel layout that is number 6 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom7: Switches to the panel layout that is number 7 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom8: Switches to the panel layout that is number 8 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutCustom9: Switches to the panel layout that is number 9 in the list of saved layouts, if there is one.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutDefault: Switches to the default built-in panel layout.
tbPanels_SetActiveLayoutFullScreen: Switches to the full screen editor panel layout.
tbPanels_ShowManagePanelLayouts: Opens the dialog for managing the saved panel layouts.
tbPanels_TogglePreventDockedMove: Turns on or off the option that stops docked panels from being moved.
tbPanels_TogglePreventDockedResize: Turns on or off the option that stops docked panels from being resized.
tbPanels_TogglePreventDockedTearout: Turns on or off the option that stops docked panels from being pulled out of their dock.
tbPanels_TogglePreventFloatingMove: Turns on or off the option that stops floating panels from being moved.
tbPanels_TogglePreventFloatingResize: Turns on or off the option that stops floating panels from being resized.
tbProblems_ClipboardCopyAll: Copies everything in the Problems panel to the clipboard as a compilation error report.
tbProblems_ClipboardCopyAllErrors: Copies the errors of the Problems panel to the clipboard as a compilation error report.
tbProblems_CollapseAll: Collapses every entry in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_ExpandAll: Expands every entry in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Problems panel.
tbProblems_ToggleShowErrors: Shows or hides the errors in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_ToggleShowHints: Shows or hides the hints in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_ToggleShowInfos: Shows or hides the information messages in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_ToggleShowWarnings: Shows or hides the warnings in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowErrorsOff: Hides the errors in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowErrorsOn: Shows the errors in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowHintsOff: Hides the hints in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowHintsOn: Shows the hints in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowInfosOff: Hides the information messages in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowInfosOn: Shows the information messages in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowWarningsOff: Hides the warnings in the Problems panel.
tbProblems_TurnShowWarningsOn: Shows the warnings in the Problems panel.
tbProject_AddCustomControlsPackage: Adds the CustomControls package to the project.
tbProject_AddWinNativeFormsPackage: Adds the WinNativeForms package to the project.
tbProject_Export: Exports the project's sources to a folder.
tbProject_FindInFiles: Opens the Find and Replace panel with the Current Project scope chosen.
tbProject_New: Opens the front page on the list of templates for a new project.
tbProject_Open: Opens the dialog for choosing a project to open.
tbProject_OpenBuildFolder: Opens the project's build folder in Windows Explorer. A project that has not been saved gets a message instead.
tbProject_OpenProjectFolder: Opens the folder that holds the project file in Windows Explorer. A project that has not been saved gets a message instead.
tbProject_OpenRecent: Opens the front page on the list of recent projects.
tbProject_SaveAllChanges: Saves the project and every document with unsaved changes.
tbProject_SaveAs: Asks for a new name and place for the project and saves it there.
tbProject_ShowSettings: Opens the project's Settings in an editor.
tbProjectExplorer_ClipboardPaste: In the Project Explorer's file view, pastes the items on the clipboard.
tbProjectExplorer_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Project Explorer.
tbProjectExplorer_ObjectList_DeleteSelec: Shows only a message box with its own name; deleting is not implemented.
tbProjectExplorer_ObjectList_RenameSelec: Shows only a message box with its own name; renaming is not implemented.
tbProjectExplorer_ObjectList_ViewSelecte: In the object view of the Project Explorer, opens the code of the selected object.
In the object view of the Project Explorer, opens the form of the selected object.
tbProjectExplorer_Search: Opens the search box of the Project Explorer's object view, or moves the focus to it.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsClipboard: In the Project Explorer's file view, copies the selected items to the clipboard.
In the Project Explorer's file view, copies the names of the selected items to the clipboard.
In the Project Explorer's file view, copies the paths of the selected items to the clipboard.
In the Project Explorer's file view, cuts the selected items to the clipboard.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsDeletePer: In the Project Explorer's file view, deletes the selected items, after asking if the Ask Before Delete Files option is on.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsExport: In the Project Explorer's file view, exports the selected items to a folder.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsRename: In the Project Explorer's file view, renames the selected item.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsViewAsJSO: In the Project Explorer's file view, opens the selected file as JSON.
tbProjectExplorer_SelectedItemsViewAsMar: In the Project Explorer's file view, opens the selected file as a Markdown preview.
tbProjectExplorer_ShowAddMenu: Opens the menu for adding a component to the project, below the Add button of the Project Explorer.
tbProjectExplorer_ToggleFileMode: Switches the Project Explorer between its file view and its object view.
tbProjectExplorer_ToggleFileModeOff: Switches the Project Explorer to its object view.
tbProjectExplorer_ToggleFileModeOn: Switches the Project Explorer to its file view.
tbProperties_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Properties panel.
tbProperties_Search: Opens the search box of the Properties panel, or moves the focus to it.
tbShowObjectBrowser: Opens the Object Browser, for the text selected in the code editor.
tbSignatureHelpCancel: Dismisses the signature help that is showing.
tbTheme_SwitchToDarkMode: Switches the IDE to the dark colour theme.
tbTheme_SwitchToggle: Switches the IDE between the dark and light colour themes.
tbTheme_SwitchToLightClassicMode: Switches the IDE to the classic light colour theme.
tbTheme_SwitchToLightMode: Switches the IDE to the light colour theme.
tbThemes_Reload: Reloads the themes from their files on disk.
tbThemes_ShowList: Opens the list of themes beside the colour mode button.
tbToolbox_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Toolbox panel.
tbToolbox_Search: Opens the search box of the Toolbox, or moves the focus to it.
tbToolbox_SelectNextTool: In the Toolbox, selects the next tool.
tbToolbox_SelectPrevTool: In the Toolbox, selects the previous tool.
tbToolbox_ShowMoreComponents: Shows a message about adding components to the Toolbox, which says to add an ordinary COM reference to the ActiveX type library.
tbToolbox_ToggleShowControlNames: Shows or hides the names of the controls in the Toolbox.
tbToolbox_TurnShowControlNamesOff: Hides the names of the controls in the Toolbox, leaving their icons.
tbToolbox_TurnShowControlNamesOn: Shows the names of the controls in the Toolbox.
tbVariables_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Variables panel.
tbWatches_Add: Adds a watch, starting from the text selected in the code editor.
tbWatches_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Watches panel.
tbWebpage_FocusPanel: Moves the focus to the Webpage panel.
tbWebpage_GoBack: Goes back one page in the Webpage panel.
tbWebpage_GoForward: Goes forward one page in the Webpage panel.
tbWebpage_Reload: Reloads the page in the Webpage panel.
tbWebpage_ToggleMobileMode: Turns the Webpage panel's Use Mobile Mode option on or off.
tbWebpage_TurnMobileModeOff: Turns the Webpage panel's Use Mobile Mode option off.
tbWebpage_TurnMobileModeOn: Turns the Webpage panel's Use Mobile Mode option on.
